name: overlay-inventory
command: p=$(/bin/busybox pidof buildkitd); grep -E 'Cap|NoNewPrivs' /proc/$p/status; buildctl debug workers; buildctl du; df -h /var/lib/buildkit

name: overlay-default-cold
command:
set -eu; mkdir -p /tmp/recipe /tmp/empty-context /var/lib/buildkit/trial; printf %s 'ARG TARGETARCH
FROM debian:trixie-slim AS base

RUN set -eux; \
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; \
    apt-get update; \
    apt-get upgrade -y; \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        ca-certificates curl git ripgrep fd-find jq less; \
    ln -s /usr/bin/fdfind /usr/local/bin/fd; \
    git config --system user.name pi; \
    git config --system user.email pi@pinfold.invalid; \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN find / -xdev -perm /6000 -type f -exec chmod a-s {} +
' > /tmp/recipe/Dockerfile; buildctl build --frontend dockerfile.v0 --local context=/tmp/empty-context --local dockerfile=/tmp/recipe --opt platform=linux/amd64 --opt build-arg:HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:3128 --opt build-arg:HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:3128 --opt build-arg:http_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:3128 --opt build-arg:https_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:3128 --no-cache --output type=oci,dest=/var/lib/buildkit/trial/overlay-default-cold,tar=false; python3 /usr/local/lib/frames.py emit /var/lib/buildkit/trial/overlay-default-cold /var/lib/buildkit/trial/overlay-default-cold.frames; buildctl du; df -h /var/lib/buildkit; sync

name: overlay-full-cold
command:
set -eu; mkdir -p /tmp/recipe /tmp/empty-context /var/lib/buildkit/trial; printf %s 'ARG TARGETARCH
FROM debian:trixie-slim AS base

RUN set -eux; \
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; \
    apt-get update; \
    apt-get upgrade -y; \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        ca-certificates curl git ripgrep fd-find jq less; \
    ln -s /usr/bin/fdfind /usr/local/bin/fd; \
    git config --system user.name pi; \
    git config --system user.email pi@pinfold.invalid; \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Only the selected architecture'\''s stage is built. Release archives stay
# in build stages; final images copy the installed files.
FROM base AS bun-arm64
ADD --checksum=sha256:efa9813da5ed72423bf847f916e8d2c47c0d776add972354026a75e10da9aa21 https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.4.3/bun-linux-aarch64.zip /tmp/bun-aarch64.zip

FROM base AS bun-amd64
ADD --checksum=sha256:3e730528d89775f03f87f05c06787c4df4099d0a37f3f252e7b829cb23816e18 https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.4.3/bun-linux-x64.zip /tmp/bun-x64.zip

FROM bun-${TARGETARCH} AS bun-install
RUN set -eux; \
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; \
    apt-get update; \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends unzip; \
    unzip -q /tmp/bun-*.zip -d /tmp/bun; \
    install -m 0755 /tmp/bun/bun-linux-*/bun /usr/local/bin/bun

FROM base AS anydoc-arm64
ADD --checksum=sha256:ed71661425a9959009d39ba495dbc565cc27a27f4eb0c93336b89f217e5c56b2 https://registry.npmjs.org/@firecrawl/anydoc-linux-arm64-gnu/-/anydoc-linux-arm64-gnu-0.2.4.tgz /tmp/anydoc-aarch64.tgz

FROM base AS anydoc-amd64
ADD --checksum=sha256:ca822ea3ad29a9b9ca6b7f6d2a6b3d5311153af25a6c35a7f5bdf0791fe7f2c9 https://registry.npmjs.org/@firecrawl/anydoc-linux-x64-gnu/-/anydoc-linux-x64-gnu-0.2.4.tgz /tmp/anydoc-x64.tgz

FROM anydoc-${TARGETARCH} AS anydoc-install
ARG TARGETARCH
ADD --checksum=sha256:625bf6cdc24cc91eee8fbfe084c1fa56c71b17f034341d4a23bc8df0fdee31bd https://registry.npmjs.org/@firecrawl/anydoc/-/anydoc-0.2.4.tgz /tmp/anydoc.tgz
RUN set -eux; \
    case "${TARGETARCH}" in \
        arm64) native=anydoc-linux-arm64-gnu ;; \
        amd64) native=anydoc-linux-x64-gnu ;; \
        *) echo "unsupported architecture ${TARGETARCH}" >&2; exit 1 ;; \
    esac; \
    anydoc=/opt/pinfold/anydoc/node_modules/@firecrawl; \
    mkdir -p "${anydoc}/anydoc" "${anydoc}/${native}"; \
    tar -xzf /tmp/anydoc.tgz --strip-components=1 -C "${anydoc}/anydoc"; \
    tar -xzf /tmp/anydoc-*.tgz --strip-components=1 -C "${anydoc}/${native}"

FROM base AS documents
COPY --from=bun-install /usr/local/bin/bun /usr/local/bin/bun
COPY --from=anydoc-install /opt/pinfold/anydoc /opt/pinfold/anydoc
RUN set -eux; \
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; \
    apt-get update; \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends poppler-utils; \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; \
    printf '\''#!/bin/sh\nexec /usr/local/bin/bun /opt/pinfold/anydoc/node_modules/@firecrawl/anydoc/cli.js "$@"\n'\'' > /usr/local/bin/anydoc; \
    chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/anydoc; \
    chmod -R a+rX /opt/pinfold/anydoc

FROM base AS fff-arm64
ADD --checksum=sha256:702bd8fe5d861fb5016a4fa0e62545a0a3e802dcc6b7232a3d02e54f0f90187e https://registry.npmjs.org/@ff-labs/fff-bin-linux-arm64-gnu/-/fff-bin-linux-arm64-gnu-0.11.0.tgz /tmp/fff-bin-aarch64.tgz

FROM base AS fff-amd64
ADD --checksum=sha256:36c5f09b7e315e4e1870fc2311dfae392d0f6e6197f3c0b0697e15d8d8344ebf https://registry.npmjs.org/@ff-labs/fff-bin-linux-x64-gnu/-/fff-bin-linux-x64-gnu-0.11.0.tgz /tmp/fff-bin-x64.tgz

FROM fff-${TARGETARCH} AS fff-install
ARG TARGETARCH
ADD --checksum=sha256:d25cacb52974a8c99be1ecf88a0ba554459402a8850798cc722e08b088d21de3 https://registry.npmjs.org/@ff-labs/pi-fff/-/pi-fff-0.11.0.tgz /tmp/pi-fff.tgz
ADD --checksum=sha256:516e6e3ff779664b455b08207d03a80b97e25d9123a579b67f6f151fda358c73 https://registry.npmjs.org/@ff-labs/fff-bun/-/fff-bun-0.11.0.tgz /tmp/fff-bun.tgz
# fff-node, pi-fff'\''s Node fallback, is deliberately not staged: pi runs extensions under Bun.
RUN set -eux; \
    case "${TARGETARCH}" in \
        arm64) native=fff-bin-linux-arm64-gnu ;; \
        amd64) native=fff-bin-linux-x64-gnu ;; \
        *) echo "unsupported architecture ${TARGETARCH}" >&2; exit 1 ;; \
    esac; \
    fff=/opt/pinfold/packages/pi-fff; \
    mkdir -p "${fff}/node_modules/@ff-labs/fff-bun" "${fff}/node_modules/@ff-labs/${native}"; \
    tar -xzf /tmp/pi-fff.tgz --strip-components=1 -C "${fff}"; \
    tar -xzf /tmp/fff-bun.tgz --strip-components=1 -C "${fff}/node_modules/@ff-labs/fff-bun"; \
    tar -xzf /tmp/fff-bin-*.tgz --strip-components=1 -C "${fff}/node_modules/@ff-labs/${native}"; \
    chmod -R a+rX "${fff}"

FROM base AS ponytail-install
ADD --checksum=sha256:d2e8ef2f98e8f70bf40ffcd3ff157634fe13b2572e10ad70a62fc26db6de6dc5 https://registry.npmjs.org/@dietrichgebert/ponytail/-/ponytail-5.3.2.tgz /tmp/ponytail.tgz
RUN set -eux; \
    mkdir -p /opt/pinfold/packages/ponytail; \
    tar -xzf /tmp/ponytail.tgz --strip-components=1 -C /opt/pinfold/packages/ponytail; \
    chmod -R a+rX /opt/pinfold/packages/ponytail

FROM documents AS full
COPY --from=fff-install /opt/pinfold/packages/pi-fff /opt/pinfold/packages/pi-fff
COPY --from=ponytail-install /opt/pinfold/packages/ponytail /opt/pinfold/packages/ponytail
RUN set -eux; \
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; \
    mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings; \
    curl -fsSL https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg \
        -o /etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg; \
    chmod go+r /etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg; \
    echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" \
        > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list; \
    apt-get update; \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gh; \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN find / -xdev -perm /6000 -type f -exec chmod a-s {} +
' > /tmp/recipe/Dockerfile; buildctl build --frontend dockerfile.v0 --local context=/tmp/empty-context --local dockerfile=/tmp/recipe --opt platform=linux/amd64 --opt build-arg:HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:3128 --opt build-arg:HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:3128 --opt build-arg:http_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:3128 --opt build-arg:https_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:3128 --no-cache --output type=oci,dest=/var/lib/buildkit/trial/overlay-full-cold,tar=false; python3 /usr/local/lib/frames.py emit /var/lib/buildkit/trial/overlay-full-cold /var/lib/buildkit/trial/overlay-full-cold.frames; buildctl du; df -h /var/lib/buildkit; sync
